action.old_text: raise NotImplementedError("implement the paper-core reproduction task")
action.new_text:
# Validate inputs
    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy ndarray")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.shape[0] == 0 or arr.shape[1] == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be non-empty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains nonfinite values")
        if not np.all(arr <= 0):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be nonpositive")

    # Check shape consistency
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Validate threshold
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be a boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
    if tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")

    # Compute weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)

    # Compute losses (weighted sum of negative log probabilities)
    loss_result = -np.sum(weights * logp_with_result, axis=1)
    loss_call_only = -np.sum(weights * logp_call_only, axis=1)
    loss_no_call = -np.sum(weights * logp_no_call, axis=1)

    # Compute deltas
    delta1 = loss_no_call - loss_result
    delta2 = loss_call_only - loss_result

    # Keep mask: both deltas > threshold
    keep_mask = (delta1 > tau_filter) & (delta2 > tau_filter)

    # Margins: minimum of the two deltas
    margins = np.minimum(delta1, delta2)

    return (keep_mask, margins)
